description: This file defines React components for a customizable dialog/modal UI, utilizing Radix UI primitives and Lucide icons.

methods.name: Dialog
methods.description: Main dialog component wrapping Radix UI Root with additional data-slot attribute.

methods.name: DialogTrigger
methods.description: Component to trigger opening the dialog, wrapping Radix UI Trigger.

methods.name: DialogPortal
methods.description: Component rendering dialog content in a portal, wrapping Radix UI Portal.

methods.name: DialogClose
methods.description: Component to close the dialog, wrapping Radix UI Close.

methods.name: DialogOverlay
methods.description: Overlay component with styling and animation, wrapping Radix UI Overlay.

methods.name: DialogContent
methods.description: Main content container for the dialog, including overlay and close button.
